title: TCS inger 2: Customizable Multilingual Zero-shot Singing Voice Synthesis

layout.note: Three lettered panels in one row: (a) the overview with a four-entry legend at its top left, (b) a narrow vertical chain, (c) a block with its side inputs; flow is bottom-up in all three, inputs sit on the bottom edge; (b) and (c) are zooms of (a) tied to it only by name.

lesson: Draw each kind of tensor as a miniature token with its own fill (plain, hatched, dotted) and put the same miniatures in a legend, so the overview and the zoom panels can show data passing between modules without extra labels.
